A '''plasma grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] that exerted pressurized gas similar to the [[Cold grenade]], except it ignited into flames when it reached the outside atmosphere. This type of grenade was not very common,
as it also generated a magnetic field that occasionally caused it to attach to the thrower's hand .

==History==
It is believed that the bounty hunter [[Calo Nord]] used plasma grenades, and might have even tried to use one when trying to kill the amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. These grenades were very rare and highly expensive, and the only military forces that used them were the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and certain [[Jedi/Legends|jedi]] who were experienced with them.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper grenadier/Legends|grenadier troopers]] were armed with small plasma grenades. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bounty hunter [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was known to use plasma grenades in his weapon's [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] attachment.
